body:
The owner asked to “Fix two required review findings” on this snapshot-41 consumer upgrade and required that “Tests must use only public contracts.” Fresh review found a borrow regression tied to a private watchdog thread name and a v1.1 regression that bypassed real transport and session negotiation.

This correction changes only the two named tests. The borrow regression uses `ManualClock` and the public close of a deliberately stalled JSON borrower to exercise the 12,000 ms deadline, while another progressing borrower must keep the lender paused. It retains the explicit-read probe, zero body delivery, zero Yamux credit, intact reply digests, dispatch order and returned reservation checks. Body counters start after real protocol negotiation, and public read readiness joins the short borrower's actual admission before time advances.

The v1.1 regression now starts isolated loopback TCP/Noise/Mplex hosts and negotiates through `Host.newStream`. It retains 100 pending requests, 64 occupied handler permits, 49 rejected completion offers with exact failure checks, admission still paused at 51, exactly one resume at 50, the open sibling stream, the complete healthy RPC reply and guarded cleanup. No production behavior, dependency pin, runner or workflow changes in this correction.

## Current review-correction proof

Both candidate rows pass on their first native attempts, with no attempt-history rows. Each negative control fails all three native attempts. All five phases use identical revised test hashes and race `scripts/test.bash --local-and-remote` serially under the shared local test lock, with hard invocation deadlines. The local side supplies these results; remote-side failure is recorded in each full launcher log.

The borrow control restores only `Libp2pHostFactory.kt` from [the pre-correction source](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/blob/c03d7e615648e0c8f89c2342c187503b3a7bc18b/src/foundation/url/protocol/Libp2pHostFactory.kt): it delivers 65,536 lender-body bytes while the assertion requires zero. The v1.1 control removes only the production outbound explicit-read adapter: real negotiation, request admission and all 49 rejected completion assertions complete, then `The real manual read must process the control frame` fails. [Full borrow stacks](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/blob/4b9155e0d6d00c2a7d2e335040018811fea27778/investigations/pr945-public-fixtures-202629/borrow-revert-red-full-stacks.txt) and [full v1.1 stacks](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/blob/4b9155e0d6d00c2a7d2e335040018811fea27778/investigations/pr945-public-fixtures-202629/v11-revert-red-full-stacks.txt) retain the complete errors. Fixed production bytes are restored after the final controls.

The adjacent search added coverage for expiry of one of two concurrent JSON borrows: that expiry must not resume the lender while the progressing borrow remains. It also removed negotiation bytes from both borrowers' body counters and joined actual short-frame admission through public read readiness. Existing real Mplex/Yamux boundary and overlapping-pause scenarios already cover the adjacent framing, mux and release-order cases. Original payloads, iteration counts, wait bounds and behavior assertions are retained. Separate test and code review passes found no remaining finding in these corrections.

## Failed remote check attribution

The original-head [failed remote check](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/runs/122442210997) never reached compilation or test execution. Its output reports five failed `createUploadSession` attempts, zero created sessions and zero chunks sent. BuildTest's `createUploadSessionStructured` RPC was refused at the shared TcpServer limit of 256 concurrent handlers before the request started. [Complete check payload](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/blob/4b9155e0d6d00c2a7d2e335040018811fea27778/investigations/pr945-public-fixtures-202629/remote-check.json), [full original stack](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/blob/4b9155e0d6d00c2a7d2e335040018811fea27778/investigations/pr945-public-fixtures-202629/remote-check-full-log.md), and [attribution](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/blob/4b9155e0d6d00c2a7d2e335040018811fea27778/investigations/pr945-public-fixtures-202629/ci-attribution.md) retain the evidence.

This is an upload-submission infrastructure failure; there is no failed test selector to compare with main, and no test failure is being labeled pre-existing. No check was rerun. This assignment stops after pushed first-attempt targeted proof, without merging, enqueueing, deploying or claiming full-suite CI is green.

## Earlier verification retained for its historical source revisions

The owner asked to “Fix two required review findings” on this open snapshot-41 consumer PR. The review found missing coverage for request-count and memory pauses active on the same stream, and a rejected-drain stress test that drove a private observer.

This correction adds eight self-contained real loopback TCP/Noise tests across Yamux and Mplex, and rewrites both the stress scenario and its single-run original using public RPC, event-loop and close calls. It changes no production behavior.

## Review correction proof

Verified clean PR head: [7e9612bd273144368ce414becaee96e693c4c364](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/commit/7e9612bd273144368ce414becaee96e693c4c364). [Dedicated proof run](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/actions/runs/40573461002); [disposable workflow source](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/blob/2f3cae7ade4b3adc14977baf5a5e14ea80aca136/.github/workflows/w4-final-proof.yml). The workflows are absent from the PR. Native XML, logs, source files and SHA-256 records are uploaded as the four stage artifacts on that run. All test and product hashes in the green proof match this clean head; every green test passes on its first attempt with no attempt-history rows. Every command races `--local-and-remote` on the GitHub runner.

The eight tests cover both release orders and the 51/50 completion boundary. Each establishes a real memory reservation wait or a genuine partial-frame borrow on the already request-paused stream, positively observes queued mux DATA, and checks zero body delivery while the restrictive owner remains (plus zero Yamux receive credit). Releasing request count first leaves memory ownership holding the body. Releasing memory first leaves automatic reads paused at 51 while explicit body and `EffectResponse` delivery work. Every case finishes with intact SHA-256 replies, one request pause/resume, returned memory capacity and owned peer cleanup.

Headers receive exactly one explicit read before the borrow is established. Lease waits observe public diagnostics without leaving an extra read authorized for future data; public outbound observations also confirm that new reads do not pass the guard while borrowing is live. The tests exercise the new explicit read issued after both owners exist.

| [Mplex 1.0 JSON reservation](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/blob/7e9612bd273144368ce414becaee96e693c4c364/tests/testRealMplexLegacyRequestAndReservationPausesCompose.kts) | FAIL (2079 ms) | PASS (2513 ms) | FAIL (1987 ms) |

| [Mplex 1.1 JSON reservation](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/blob/7e9612bd273144368ce414becaee96e693c4c364/tests/testRealMplexV11RequestAndReservationPausesCompose.kts) | FAIL (1983 ms) | PASS (2537 ms) | FAIL (1993 ms) |
| [Yamux attachment reservation](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/blob/7e9612bd273144368ce414becaee96e693c4c364/tests/testRealYamuxAttachmentRequestAndReservationPausesCompose.kts) | FAIL (1949 ms) | PASS (2491 ms) | FAIL (1948 ms) |
| [Yamux 1.0 JSON reservation](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/blob/7e9612bd273144368ce414becaee96e693c4c364/tests/testRealYamuxLegacyRequestAndReservationPausesCompose.kts) | FAIL (1930 ms) | PASS (2500 ms) | FAIL (1959 ms) |
| [Yamux attachment borrow](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/blob/7e9612bd273144368ce414becaee96e693c4c364/tests/testRealYamuxRequestAndBorrowPausesCompose.kts) | FAIL (2061 ms) | PASS (3514 ms) | FAIL (2071 ms) |

The separate incorrect-combination control changes only `all` to `any` while preserving the no-owner case: all eight fail on the first attempt at the intended held-body assertion. Both actual product reversals restore only `Libp2pHostFactory.kt` from [the pre-correction source](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/blob/c03d7e615648e0c8f89c2342c187503b3a7bc18b/src/foundation/url/protocol/Libp2pHostFactory.kt); all eight likewise fail at that assertion, with test hashes unchanged.

The public-only drain tests fill the live ordinary and tail queues through Netty's public APIs, observe the real rejection diagnostic, and require a separate public close caller to return while that diagnostic is held. They wait for exactly every accepted task before teardown and check caller and close-future outcomes. The single scenario passes first attempt in 2553 ms; the mandatory 512-scenario stress passes first attempt in 62554 ms. Its iteration count, 1,800-second test limit, 30-second scenario limit and existing step limits are unchanged. Neither test reconstructs the private observer attribute or its event strings.

Independent test and adversarial reviews covered the revised tests. The adjacent-gap search added attachment-reservation variants and actual control delivery after borrow-first release, corrected acquisition/negotiation checkpoints, and put emergency permit release inside guarded cleanup. No concrete remaining finding was identified for the requested post-pause behavior. Normal required PR CI is left to run; this assignment stops after the pushed targeted proof, without merge, queue admission or deployment.

Verified source commit: [fcdf4c0adc2658701d20357d81e1bd73b034c63e](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/commit/fcdf4c0adc2658701d20357d81e1bd73b034c63e). The candidate XML contains exactly four passing test rows and no retry history. Both removal stages fail with the assertion `The real manual read must process the control frame`; all three automatic native attempts fail in each case. The candidate product SHA-256 is `f8c1481d1d1872228247cb56bd5a7ee0d9efe6a668fa556fd5638c2bd63ac4e2`. All four test hashes are identical across the initial removal, candidate and final removal, and match this PR commit. The runner log identifies the local side as the race winner; remote cancellation later timed out after local results were already returned.

Every case admits 100 real requests, fills the live server event-loop queue until actual rejection, verifies 49 rejected completion notifications, explicitly receives the peer control frame with 51 requests remaining and automatic reads still paused, then completes the next request and requires exactly one resume at 50. An intact later RPC reply and the still-open shared child verify continued progress. Each test checks the negotiated framing, authenticated peer, actual TCP parent and selected real muxer; no transport or session is substituted.

The negative control removes only the production explicit-read adapter. The restored candidate and both removal stages retain identical test hashes. Native XML establishes the first attempt of each test; later native retries are not counted as successful evidence. Every test command uses `scripts/test.bash --local-and-remote` on the disposable GitHub runner, with a hard invocation deadline. The workflow is confined to the verification branch and is absent from this PR.

The detailed review and README require explicit control delivery through a request-count pause. Frame-reservation and borrow pauses continue to block explicit body delivery in the unchanged neighboring real-stack tests. The brief's wording that every explicit request-count read must block body bytes contradicts that documented contract; this correction preserves the requested review behavior.

The coverage search included the existing real pending-request Yamux/Mplex cases, legacy/v1.1 rejected-completion fixtures, admission and borrow probes, and idle reconciliation tests. The new matrix closes the missing real-mux positive explicit-read route in both framings; no additional concrete gap was found.

## CI dispatch finding

The workflow did dispatch for the reviewed head [51059d74e3a5826084ebdb45cf964026ddf0c3f0](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/commit/51059d74e3a5826084ebdb45cf964026ddf0c3f0): [Bld - All Tests](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/actions/runs/40553227741) started from `pull_request` at 2026-10-27 17:43:15 UTC. Its four shard jobs were still executing their test steps at investigation time. The workflow's `bld-all-tests` job has `needs: [test-shard]`, so the aggregate check waits for all four shards; this was not a missing dispatch. [Bld - Build](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/actions/runs/40553227939) succeeded. No job was rerun; the PR update triggers normal fresh CI. Per the scoped brief, this continuation stops after pushed first-attempt targeted proof and does not claim full-suite CI completion.

## Earlier correction and consumer work

The owner asked for the open snapshot-41 consumer handoff to be finished. Review of this PR found that explicit caller reads deliver body bytes to a server stream while its frame reservation is waiting, and to a lender stream while its capacity is borrowed. This change corrects that read path while retaining explicit reads through a request-count pause.

The RPC read guard now records whether each active pause owner permits explicit input. Caller reads reconcile published request completions, then proceed only when every remaining owner permits them. Frame-reservation and borrow owners hold explicit reads; decoder continuation reads still wait for every owner to release. The README describes this behavior.

## Review correction evidence

Source head: [`51059d74e3a5826084ebdb45cf964026ddf0c3f0`](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/commit/51059d74e3a5826084ebdb45cf964026ddf0c3f0). With only `Libp2pHostFactory.kt` restored to its pre-fix version, [both probes failed again](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/blob/45c30574a/investigations/pr945-admission-W4-171708/product-revert.xml): admission observed 262102 body bytes while paused (first attempt 2874 ms), and borrow observed 65536 lender bytes while borrowed (first attempt 6632 ms), both expecting zero. Each failed all three automatic native attempts. [Provenance and unchanged test hashes](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/blob/45c30574a/investigations/pr945-admission-W4-171708/product-revert-provenance.json) establish that every test was retained. The exact fixed product bytes were then restored and the working tree was clean. [Native summary](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/blob/45c30574a/investigations/pr945-admission-W4-171708/native-summary.json).

The gap search found that existing borrow-budget tests did not issue an explicit caller read and send a lender body while its capacity was borrowed. The new standalone regression covers that case with real TCP/Noise/Yamux transport and observes receiver DATA, child delivery, receive credit, preserved progress allowances, intact replies and final reservation release. The original admission probe covers both JSON versions and attachment reservation. The immediate neighbors cover request-only pause reconciliation at 51/50 pending requests, rejected completion publication, idle accounting and Mplex connection scope. Separate test and code review passes found no further issue; this continuation verified their findings against the unchanged candidate.

Every targeted invocation used `scripts/test.bash --local-and-remote`; first-attempt counts come from native test XML. Both remote sides returned a STARTING health response and the CLI continued with the local result. No test bound, workload count, assertion or transport pin was loosened. Required full-suite CI will run normally after this update; this scoped verification does not claim its outcome.

## Earlier consumer work

This PR pins `community.kotlin.libp2p:jvm-libp2p:1.3.0-codexcoder21-snapshot-41`, retains Yamux flow control behind wrapped sessions, uses the existing physical-close retry API, preserves released-reader close diagnostics, and retains main's effect-scope behavior. It also corrects two test fixture teardown preconditions with permanent 512-scenario regressions. The duplicate full-suite step was removed from the build-only workflow; both workflow files match main.

The previous nine-row qualification and all limitations remain available in [the description before this correction](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/blob/45c30574a/investigations/pr945-admission-W4-171708/pr-description-before.md). Those historical results do not replace the new pause-read checks above. [Earlier qualification evidence](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/tree/evidence/W4-945-qualification-124648) and [paired streamed-reply attribution](https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/tree/evidence/W4-945-streamed-comparison-141740) retain the full comparisons and native attempts.

No merge, enqueue, deployment, publication or CI rerun was performed in this continuation.
